name: Baneful Bunker
effect: Reaction. Shield Move. May be used to redirect a move away from an Ally. Reduce the damage the User takes by their Rank. If the move that strikes the User is a Contact move, the foe is now Badly Poisoned.
description: The user encloses itself inside it's sturdy shell of which is covered in poisonous barbs. If a barb pricks the foe's skin, the wound would start to fester. Draws the laughter of everyone in the fight because you're playing a Toxapex.
